name: Dev Feedback Capture
summary: Local-first Chromium extension and project-scoped MCP companion for actionable visual change specs.
requirements: Download and unzip the latest GitHub Release asset
Developer Mode in Chrome, Edge, or another Chromium browser
Manual Load unpacked installation from the unzipped extension folder
Optional MCP companion: Node.js 18 or newer, npm install, and an MCP-compatible local client

privacy.summary: Feedback stays in local extension storage or an explicitly selected project sidecar. Capture, export, and MCP import actions are user-triggered, and no cloud sync or hosted AI integration is included.

distribution.current: Chrome Web Store v1.6 is public. GitHub Release v1.2.0 remains available for manual unpacked installation.
distribution.planned: Publish v1.7 only after the recorded browser and agent-handoff release gates pass, then align the catalog download link.
distribution.downloadUrlPolicy: Resolve the latest release asset at publish time instead of hardcoding a stale versioned URL.

highlights: Element capture with selectors and notes
Reversible visual edit previews with original versus proposed evidence
Annotated region specs with DOM anchors and acceptance checks
Local AI Bundle export with structured context and evidence images
Project-scoped stdio MCP companion for local coding agents
